profile.headline: Software Engineering | Junior Software Developer @ BYUI | Data Science Minor | Full-Stack Web Development | React.js, Python, C#, SQL | System Automation | API Integration | Full-Stack & Data Science Certified
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineering student at Brigham Young University - Idaho with a minor in Data Science, expecting to graduate in December 2026. Backed by certifications in Full-Stack Web Development and Data Science, I specialize in building scalable web applications, designing robust databases, and automating complex workflows. My technical toolkit includes modern languages and frameworks such as React.js, Python, C#, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. I am passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and solving real-world problems through efficient software architecture.

In my current role as a Junior Software Developer at BYU-I, I build enterprise-level full-stack applications for inventory management utilizing React and C#, and ensure seamless deployment through GitHub Actions. A major focus of my work involves process optimization. I recently engineered automated provisioning workflows for hundreds of online courses using Google Apps Script and developed custom Canvas API dashboards, collectively saving university staff dozens of hours of manual data entry. Prior to this, I served as a Volunteer Software Analyst for the Madison Fire Department, where I architected normalized SQLite database schemas for a real-time asset management system that tracked over 200 items for emergency personnel.

Beyond my professional roles, I continuously refine my engineering skills through complex independent projects. I developed "Vitality Vista," a full-stack fitness application integrated with third-party REST APIs, and "Kairo," a voice-first journal that leverages AI models like Whisper and BERT for transcription and sentiment analysis. I am currently seeking software engineering opportunities where I can apply my background in full-stack development, system automation, and data structures to a collaborative and innovative team.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered a full-stack web application using React.js and C# to manage inventory and user administrative roles, establishing CI/CD deployment pipelines via GitHub Actions and Nginx.

Streamlined the course setup workflow by developing an automation solution with Google Apps Script (JavaScript), processing data from Google Sheets to configure over 375 online courses per semester.

Generated automated Trello setup and review pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet coordination and optimizing operations for 25 staff members.

Managed the technical integration of third-party educational LTI tools (including McGraw Hill and Perusall) directly into the Canvas LMS environment.

Architected and maintained internal API abstraction layers for Canvas and Trello, standardizing integrations and reducing repetitive configuration code across the engineering team.

Built a responsive student dashboard utilizing the Canvas API to trace enrollment and assignments for 250+ students, eliminating hours of manual course logging for academic advisors.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Contributed to the development and implementation of automated systems to improve course delivery and efficiency across BYU–Idaho's online campus. Maintained high standards in digital learning environments by ensuring consistent quality and structure in Canvas and other educational platforms.

- Personally responsible for setting up 25% of all online courses offered by BYU–Idaho each semester.
- Regularly exceeded weekly setup goals by 120%, managing the creation of over 10 full 14-week courses per week.
- Oversaw 20% of quality assurance efforts to ensure ongoing consistency and reliability in course structure and digital materials.
- Supported the team in streamlining course setup processes using custom-built automation tools that improved productivity and accuracy

positions.title: Quality Assurance Associate
positions.description:
My responsibility as a Quality Assurance (QA) specialist in the Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector is to make sure that all processes and procedures are carried out in line with client requirements and industry standards. I am in charge of keeping an eye on, assessing, and identifying agents' performance in order to help them grow and develop.

My main objective is to make sure that clients continue to receive high-quality services while also making sure that agents follow compliance rules and guidelines. I collaborate closely with various divisions, including operations, training, and human resources, to make sure best practices are being followed and to put new policies in place as necessary to raise standards overall.

My daily tasks include conducting quality evaluations, analyzing data to spot trends, coaching and providing feedback to agents, performing root cause analyses, and working with stakeholders to put corrective and preventative measures into place. To make sure that our evaluations are uniform and in line with client expectations, I also regularly hold quality calibration sessions with team leaders and managers.

Overall, it's imperative for me to play the part of a QA expert in the BPO sector in ensuring that our clients receive high-quality service and that our agents are knowledgeable and skilled enough to perform their jobs successfully.
